shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- App.tsx ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- index.html ---\\n' && cat index.html && printf '\\n--- styles? ---\\n' && rg --files -g '*.css' -g '*.scss' -g 'AGENTS.md' ."
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short 2>/dev/null || true; git diff -- src/App.tsx src/App.css src/main.tsx 2>/dev/null | head -260; nl -ba src/App.tsx | sed -n '1,180p'"
